## Goal
- Perform traceable production QA for member registration, member/owner authentication and authorization, OTP security, platform parity, deployment, and canonical SHA evidence for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Do not create repositories, forks, duplicate projects, or temporary branches unless explicitly approved.
- Do not expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal test identities.
- Do not claim commit deployment, ownership, or full QA completion without verifiable evidence.
- Do not mutate/deploy production until OTP security and required QA gates are verified.
- Do not mark Android, iOS, web, registration, member sign-in, or owner sign-in PASS unless actually executed against production.

## Progress
### Done
- Re-probed public production surfaces:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  https://ivxholding.com → 200
  ```
- Production `/health` and `/version` identify the live backend as:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  bootTime=2026-08-03T11:49:24.393Z
  ```
- Production self-reports healthy AI/provider/runtime status:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "healthy",
    "aiStartupValidation": {
      "ok": true,
      "provider": "vercel_ai_gateway",
      "model": "openai/gpt-4o"
    },
    "seniorDeveloperRuntime": {
      "github": {"canReadRepo": true, "canPush": true},
      "render": {"canDeploy": true}
    },
    "ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalVerification": {
      "verified": true,
      "executionPath": "github_git_data_api"
    }
  }
  ```
  - This remains runtime self-reporting, not independent GitHub/Render provenance.
- Anonymous protected-owner API rejection was executed against production:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/autonomous/qa → 401
  {"ok":false,"error":"IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token."}
  ```
- Invalid production registration request was executed without creating a member:
  ```text
  POST /api/members/register → 400
  {
    "ok": false,
    "code": "INVALID_EMAIL",
    "stage": "VALIDATING",
    "message": "First name and last name are required."
  }
  ```
  - Validates public endpoint availability and server-side rejection; validation ordering means this request did not independently prove email validation.
- Confirmed production registration/login endpoints are rate-limited in `backend/hono.ts`:
  ```text
  member-register: limit 5, refill 0.3
  member-login: limit 5, refill 0.5
  member-forgot: limit 3, refill 0.1
  ```
- Local OTP-security repair was applied in `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`:
  - Replaced `Math.random()` generation with `randomInt(0, 10)`.
  - Added salted `scrypt` hashes with `timingSafeEqual`.
  - Replaced fallback `FallbackCodeRecord.code` with `codeHash`.
  - Added fallback resend ceiling `MAX_RESENDS = 3`.
  - Changed Supabase `verification_codes.code` writes and comparisons to use hashes.
  - Removed OTP code from `VerificationResult`, preventing it from being returned by this service.
- Local registration contract repair was applied in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`:
  - `gender` is optional, matching the stated requirement.
  - `confirmPassword` mismatch is rejected before registration.
- Local TypeScript check passed after repairing an intermediate type error:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  ```
- Local working tree at last check contains only:
  ```text
  M backend/api/ivx-members.ts
  M backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts
  ```
  - The earlier unrelated `blueprint.json` timestamp mutation is no longer present in `git status --short`.
- Earlier local checks remain evidenced:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run lint   # Expo; warnings only
  node scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
  {"status":"ok","version":"1.9.4","landingReferences":4}
  ```
- Public-chat smoke request previously passed:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat → 200
  answer="The answer is 4."
  persistence=supabase
  ```
  - Response had `source:"fallback"` and does not prove primary AI-model execution.

### In Progress
- Add focused OTP security regression tests for hashed storage, expiration, single use, invalid attempts, resend ceiling, and non-disclosure.
- Capture untruncated totals and exit codes for:
  ```text
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  bun test backend/
  bun test                 # cwd=expo
  ```
- Inspect affected registration tests and adjust/add coverage for optional gender and password confirmation.
- Audit remaining public registration validation paths individually: first/last name, DOB, phone, email, password strength, consent, duplicate email/phone, idempotency/loading behavior.
- Run real authorized production member and owner flows only after secure test-session access is available.
- Determine whether the local OTP repair is complete and deployable without weakening Supabase schema/database behavior.

### Blocked
- No approved authenticated member or owner session is available in this environment; cannot perform real production registration completion, OTP retrieval/verification, member sign-in, owner sign-in, password reset completion, owner-module access, or authenticated Supabase-record inspection.
- Canonical GitHub authentication is unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → 401
  ```
- Canonical private repository lookup without valid credentials returns:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform → 404
  ```
- Local checkout remote is not directly canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  origin=https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Canonical GitHub Actions, commit graph, PR/review/merge status, CI URLs, artifacts, and deployment statuses cannot be independently verified.
- Render deployment ID/API evidence and GitHub HEAD ↔ Render SHA parity cannot be independently verified.
- Android production build, iOS production/test environment, web browser E2E, Android emulator, and iOS simulator flows have not been executed for the live SHA.
- Live production is still SHA `012bb088...`; it cannot contain the current local OTP/registration repairs until canonical commit, review/merge, deployment, and parity verification are completed.
- Full backend/Expo suite pass totals were not captured due to truncated command output.
- Historical canonical workflow evidence for `012bb088...` included failures/skips:
  ```text
  Android release consistency: failure
  Android release APK: skipped
  Playwright E2E (web surface): skipped
  IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline: failure
  Android Emulator QA: failure
  Lint: failure
  TypeScript typecheck: failure
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Overall audit remains **BLOCKED**: none of the final PASS criteria can be claimed from local changes, anonymous probes, mocked tests, or runtime self-reporting.
- Treat `/health` and `/version` as evidence only that SHA `012bb088...` is live.
- Do not deploy the existing live OTP fallback as production-certified: the known plaintext fallback existed on the currently deployed SHA.
- Keep the OTP repair local until focused tests, full required checks, canonical review/merge, deployment, and live SHA parity are available.
- Do not create a real production test member without an authorized secure workflow that can verify and clean up/audit the account without exposing OTPs or credentials.
- Anonymous `401` is valid evidence that at least one owner-protected route rejects missing credentials; it is not evidence that a regular authenticated member is denied all owner routes.
- Treat production self-reported GitHub/Render capability as health evidence only; require external canonical GitHub and Render records for deployment certification.

## Next Steps
- 1. Add and run isolated tests for `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` covering hash-only persistence, correct/incorrect code behavior, max attempts, expiration, single use, and resend limit.
- 2. Run and capture explicit totals/exit codes:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts
  bun test backend/
  bun test                 # cwd=expo
  bun run lint             # cwd=expo
  ```
- 3. Run production build and actual web/Android/iOS E2E only in supported authenticated test environments.
- 4. Obtain valid canonical GitHub authentication; retrieve `main` HEAD, Actions runs, required check conclusions, commit history, and deployment metadata.
- 5. Obtain approved secure owner/member session handling outside chat; execute one unique non-sensitive test-member registration through email and phone verification.
- 6. Inspect sanitized Supabase Auth/profile/member records; verify exactly one record, identity mapping, timestamps, role, registration source, and absence of password/OTP plaintext.
- 7. Execute member login, failure cases, logout/session persistence, reset completion, and regular-member owner-route/API rejection.
- 8. Execute owner login, session recovery, Dashboard, Admin Hub, Members, Investors, Buyers, Properties, Deals, Registration Administration, Settings, and Variables authorization.
- 9. Commit only to verified canonical repository, submit approved review/merge to production branch, deploy backend/web, produce mobile build, and capture source SHA/build IDs.
- 10. Verify live health/version SHA equals canonical GitHub HEAD and Render deployment SHA; then publish the required concise evidence package.

## Critical Context
- Current live production identity:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  deploymentMarker=ivx-owner-ai-hono-autodeploy-live (see commit+bootTime for freshness)
  ```
- Latest local commit previously observed:
  ```text
  615fcd97045fcf6978e47d7aeed09d4e2ff69aa6
  Updated member registration features and verified system status.
  ```
- Earlier claimed local commit remains different from production:
  ```text
  2b262204efb2f8c6cd7ed87a519b83cb83a52e93
  ```
- Local `main` was previously ahead of the configured router remote by three commits; production SHA `012bb088...` was absent from local object database.
- Existing deployed OTP policy source declared:
  ```text
  CODE_TTL_MINUTES = 10
  CODE_LENGTH = 6
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  ```
- Current local OTP repair adds:
  ```text
  MAX_RESENDS = 3
  CODE_HASH_PREFIX = 'scrypt'
  ```
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` still documents a schema-missing fallback and filesystem/durable-store behavior. The schema and runtime persistence behavior must be tested before deployment.
- `getSupabaseAdmin()` in member/registration services permits anon-key fallback when service-role configuration is absent. Confirm RLS and server-side authorization in the real deployed environment before certification.
- Production public registration endpoint exists and accepts POST:
  ```text
  /api/members/register
  ```
- Production registration/verification routes include:
  ```text
  /api/members/send-email-code
  /api/members/verify-email
  /api/members/send-phone-code
  /api/members/verify-phone
  /api/members/login
  /api/members/forgot-password
  /api/members/verification-status
  ```
- Existing targeted-test output emitted local environment warnings:
  ```text
  [IVXOwnerVariables] Runtime value bridge unavailable
  Owner Variables database URL is missing.
  ```
  - The command output was truncated before a reliable final total could be recorded.
- Expo lint has warnings including unused symbols/import order/duplicate imports; no captured fatal lint error from the local run.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: OTP generation, Supabase/durable fallback persistence, verification policy; locally modified for hash-only OTP handling.
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`: registration validation and member verification/login handlers; locally modified for optional gender and confirmation-password validation.
- `backend/hono.ts`: production member route registration and rate-limit wrappers.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: Supabase member/auth operations and key selection behavior.
- `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: idempotent registration orchestration and member-role persistence.
- `backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts`: registration reliability mocks/tests; needs final captured totals and supplemental validation coverage.
- `backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts`: autonomous deployment rollback regression coverage.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: owner authorization guard and response controls.
- `expo/shared/ivx`: trusted request/session resolution used by owner authorization.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml`: backend tests, Android release consistency, and APK build workflow.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: root/Expo typechecks, Expo lint, and Playwright web E2E workflow.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-qa-suite.yml`: backend/Expo tests, critical-file test, production QA matrix, evidence generation, and artifacts.
- `expo/app/login.tsx`: member/owner login and recovery UI.
- `expo/app/owner-access.tsx`: owner access and password-reset UI.
- `expo/app/reset-password.tsx`: reset-password UI.
- `expo/package.json`: Expo test/build scripts.
- `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`: validates Expo config, Gradle, and landing APK URL version parity.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: Android APK/QR references locally aligned to `v1.9.4`.
- `expo/app.config.ts`: Expo app version source, currently `1.9.4`.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: Android version source checked by release-consistency validation.
